title: 序章11 剧变序章12 红与黄的矿坑
content_zh:
她虽然实力不俗，但却不擅长应付黄金狮子这种以肉体、血脉、传承着称的种族，之前想偷吸格莱尔精气时，没少被抓住狂扁。
“我要是不来，黄金狮子的信用可就要折损了。”
格莱尔没好气的说道，但手上动作却是没停，一把抱起黎木。
但黎木个头太大，扛着会有过量的接触，格莱尔只能放弃肩扛，转而搀扶着他离开。
莉莉娅没再说什么，只是深深看了黎木一眼...
回去的路上。
狮女扶着黎木，而那位狼女也正好回牢房。
她此刻正穿着狱警的衣服，唯一的不同就是没有戴面具。
格莱尔没有说话，狼女表情也依旧冷淡，就那么冷漠的擦肩而过。
然而，一反常态的是，在彼此错开几个身位后，狼女却停了下来。
“你如果想逃出去，那就好好珍惜这一周吧。”
话说完，狼女便离开了。
留下狮女冷漠的眼神，以及黎木暗中的心惊。
说到底，自己对这个监狱，对这个世界，还是一无所知。
......
时光荏苒。
黎木一如既往地锻炼，肉眼可见的身体厚实了不少。
但今天的监狱，却显得有些不同。
一大早，排队打饭的犯人们就吵闹个不停。
“听说了吗，那些愚蠢的贵族今天要来做什么。”

“好像是什么音乐会？”
“音乐会？真是可笑，明明是什么文化底蕴都没有的愚蠢民族！”
然而，就在这时一道脚步声响起。
“哒~哒~”
声音明明不响，却久久回荡，在每个异族耳边响起。
“虽然马尔提雅人身体素质、历史底蕴非常差，但不得不承认，他们的魔力亲和性很强。”
狮女一如往常给黎木介绍道。
黎木现在也学了不少当地词句，仅仅一周就掌握了基础语法，并能做到简单交流了。
然而，就在这时，旁边的队伍里，一个身材矮小的女孩却不屑地说道：“可怜的是，他们的魔法天赋，也不过是魔法堡的失败产物赐予的。”
女孩身着光鲜亮丽，仿佛精致的娃娃一般，让人忍不住心生喜欢。
但她的眼神中，透露着异常的冷冽，比起狼女严肃的眼神还要“刺骨”
那种眼神，就仿佛是“俯瞰”
“......”
格莱尔看到来者，表情瞬间就变了，“是七源。
content_en:
Although she is very powerful, she is not good at dealing with a race like the Golden Lion, which is famous for its body, bloodline, and inheritance. She was often caught and beaten when she tried to secretly absorb Glare's essence.
"If I don't come, Golden Lion's credibility will be damaged."
Greer said angrily, but he did not stop moving his hands and picked up Li Mu.
But Li Mu was too big, and carrying him would cause too much contact. Greer had no choice but to give up carrying him on his shoulders and help him leave instead.
Lilia said nothing more, just took a deep look at Li Mu...
On the way back.
The lion girl supported Li Mu, and the wolf girl just returned to the cell.
She was currently wearing the clothes of a prison guard, the only difference being that she was not wearing a mask.
Greer didn't speak, and the wolf girl's expression remained cold, and she just passed by him indifferently.
However, uncharacteristically, after staggering a few positions from each other, the wolf girl stopped.
"If you want to escape, then cherish this week."
After saying that, the wolf girl left.
The lion girl's cold eyes were left behind, as well as Li Mu's secret fear.
After all, I still know nothing about this prison or this world.
...
Time flies.
Li Mu exercised as usual, and his body was noticeably thicker to the naked eye.
But today's prison looks a little different.
Early in the morning, the prisoners queuing up for meals were noisy.
"Have you heard what those stupid nobles are going to do today?"
"What kind of concert is this?"
"Concert? It's really ridiculous. They are obviously a stupid nation with no cultural heritage!"
However, at this moment, footsteps sounded.
"Da~da~"
The sound was obviously silent, but it echoed for a long time, ringing in the ears of every alien.
"Although the physical fitness and historical background of the Martian people are very poor, we have to admit that their affinity for magic is very strong."
The lion girl introduced Li Mu as usual.
Li Mu has now learned a lot of local words and phrases, mastered basic grammar in just one week, and can communicate simply.
However, at this moment, a short girl in the team next to them said disdainfully: "What a pity, their magic talents are only given by the failed products of the Magic Castle."
The girl is dressed brightly and looks like an exquisite doll, which makes people fall in love with her.
But there was an unusual coldness in her eyes, which was even more "piercing" than the wolf girl's serious eyes.
That kind of look is like "looking down"
"..."
Greer's expression changed instantly when he saw the person coming, "It's Qiyuan.
